title: This Whale Swims About 10,000 Miles Every Year

scenes.text: This whale swims about 10,000 miles every year.
Gray whales travel from the Arctic to the warm lagoons of Baja, Mexico.
Their calves are born around 15 feet long and 2,000 pounds.
Adults reach about 49 feet and 90,000 pounds.
Then they turn around and swim all the way back.
The longest migration of any mammal. Ten thousand miles, then again next year.

description:
Gray whales travel about 10,000 miles round trip between the Arctic and the lagoons of Baja, Mexico.
It is the longest migration of any mammal.
How far have you ever traveled in one year?
first_comment: How far have you traveled in a single year?
